_comment: Manifest of one experiment, written BEFORE the run. The gate check_experiment_manifest.py fails if any required field is missing or if the experiment violates the standing rules (no additions, no juggling, a checked manipulation).
title: Remove the record: what the cell does when it has no memory of the resource
question: When the cell has no record of the resource, does its behaviour follow the situation?
symptom: The trap of inaction (S22: baseline 0.340 vs greedy_ema 0.166) and the falling fraction able to act (0.31 -> 0.17) are measured facts that no mechanism has explained.
first_hand_where: S22, E10, E1, E7 - all run by us

manipulation_reaches_dynamics.how: the arms differ in plastic_eta (0.0 vs 0.05) and the gate reads pred only when plastic_eta > 0, so the record arm and the no-record arm MUST diverge; checked by comparing the first 50 steps of both arms

sensitivity.expected_spread_of_the_readout: unknown - this is the first measurement of situation_explained in this world
sensitivity.why_it_can_still_be_run: the readout is a WITHIN-CELL statistic, not a between-arm difference, so it does not need the same power calculation as an arm comparison
